caption: The drawing depicts a single fish oriented horizontally with its head to the left and tail to the right, positioned centrally on a plain light beige background. The fish has a streamlined body with a light brown to yellowish-brown coloration, darker on the dorsal (top) side and paler on the ventral (bottom) side. The body features a subtle pattern of darker spots along the upper half. Three prominent dorsal fins, all triangular and colored a reddish-brown, run along the top of the fish, with the first dorsal fin largest and the subsequent fins gradually smaller toward the tail. The caudal (tail) fin, also reddish-brown, is short and rounded. The pectoral and pelvic fins are smaller, reddish with a hint of transparency, and are located just behind the gill opening and ventrally near the head, respectively. The fish has a single visible round eye with a light blue-green iris. The open mouth appears slightly upturned and pinkish in color. There is no other object or background detail in the drawing.
title: Fish Woodcarving
